name: 11/28 TAC Legion 2
rem:
Rules
• R4s: set map labels before the battle begins.
• Teams A and B go counter-clockwise; Team C clockwise (19, 28, 30); Team D takes the internal hubs 31, 27.
• Team A: be back at 21 before the Garrison stage opens.
• Team B follows Team A and holds what it captured — no recaptures.
• Temple of Tides: D enters first, B second, A last — the strongest Team A player enters last.
• Team C stays home to defend our territory and Garrison 24.

groups.note: Route: counter-clockwise 19 → 21 → 24 → 29. R4s: set map labels before the battle begins.
Route: counter-clockwise. R4s: set map labels before the battle begins.

Push towards the counter-clockwise alliance in most cases, as their Garrison is closer. Keep advancing into enemy territory, but come back to 21 before the Garrison stage opens. Team B takes over the buildings behind you.
Follow Team A. Secure captured buildings. Use extra marches to capture weaker enemy buildings. Prevent recaptures.
Capture 19, 28, 30. Secure internal Transit Hubs 19, 28, 30, 31, 27, 18. Block river crossings and hold the frontline. If no threats from the enemy, cross over at 19, 28, 30.
Capture 31, 27, then the remaining internal buildings.
Capture enemy Garrison 24 and hand it off to Team B. Push toward 29 to block the central transfer.
Take over the enemy Garrison. Hold captured buildings and key hubs; free Team A to advance.
Capture and defend home Garrison 24. Keep protecting the boundary hubs.
Reinforce home Garrison 24. Protect internal territory. Support Team C.
③ ENTER LAST — weakest first, the strongest Team A player enters last.
Stay behind to defend our territory and Garrison 24 — don't enter the Temple.
